The release verifier passed for the generated APK and the named copy in .tooling/releases.
Samsung SM-G998B updated in place from 0.1.1 (2) to 0.1.2 (3); install took 28.39 seconds and process start took 0.74 seconds.
Google Pixel 10 Pro XL on Android 16 installed 0.1.2 (3) in airplane mode; install took 15.78 seconds and process start took 1.1 seconds.
Wi-Fi was disabled and the owner confirmed no SIM; airplane mode was not enforced, so the strict airplane-mode protocol remains pending.
This update retains m1-fixture.2, so it proves signing and versionCode update mechanics but not activation of a changed snapshot.
